hero.title: Software Developer
hero.pitch: I build full-stack web applications with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, backed by automated tests.
hero.location: Banja Luka area, Bosnia and Herzegovina

about.body: I started learning web development through The Odin Project and stayed involved long enough to become a maintainer. Since then, I've built and deployed my own full-stack applications, from frontend to API and database. I care about keeping software reliable through automated testing, code review, and CI/CD.

odin.curriculum: Completed the Full Stack JavaScript curriculum.
odin.review: I review pull requests, triage issues, and collaborate with contributors to keep the curriculum up to date.
odin.tooling: I improve lessons and repository tooling, including custom ESLint rules for curriculum conventions.

metr.description: I participate in research on the impact of AI tools on developer productivity. I've completed 200+ tasks across personal and open-source projects, with and without AI assistance.

atlas.name: Atlas Univerziteta
atlas.description: An open-source directory of universities and study programs in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Croatia, and Montenegro. Includes search, user sign-in, and administrator review of suggested data corrections.

waldo.name: Where's Waldo?
waldo.description: A browser game with a zoomable image, timed gameplay, and a leaderboard. The React frontend connects to a separate Express/Prisma API with JWT authentication.
